senses.gloss: f. (זוד) wilful act; use of the stem זוד in the Bible text.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 16a:7">Snh. 16ᵃ</cite> <he>אתיא ה׳ ה׳ וכ׳</he> an analogy is drawn between the law concerning the false prophet (<he>יזיד</he> <cite ref="Deuteronomy 18:20">Deut. XVIII, 20</cite>) and that concerning the rebellious elder (<he>בזרון</he>, ib. XVII, 12). Ib. <he>והא ה׳ כי כתיבא וכ׳</he> but is not the term ‘wilfulness’ used in connection with death penalty?
